name: t1_tool_choice_grep
title: Search instead of reading 300 files
stressor: 300 small modules where the exact answer is one anchored regex away (grep/glob) but reading files one by one costs hundreds of steps; decoys reward a precise pattern: comment-only and docstring mentions, a call without a definition, handle_retry_async / _handle_retry look-alikes, and a markdown file quoting the definition
